clinic.name: South Bay Prosthodontics
clinic.tagline: The Art and Science of Specialized Dentistry

treatmentJourney.title: Comprehensive Specialist Consultation
treatmentJourney.description: Your journey begins with a thorough evaluation using advanced digital technology like PIC and digital scanning to create a personalized blueprint for your full mouth rehabilitation.

treatmentJourney.title: Collaborative Digital Planning
treatmentJourney.description: Our prosthodontists act as dental architects, designing your new smile and bite while coordinating with a network of oral surgeons and specialists for a unified plan.

treatmentJourney.title: Foundation & Surgical Phase
treatmentJourney.description: Any necessary extractions or implant placements are performed with precision, utilizing our advanced technology to ensure a stable base for your future restorations.

treatmentJourney.title: Provisional Functional Testing
treatmentJourney.description: Temporary solutions are provided to ensure you can eat, speak, and smile confidently while we test the aesthetics and function of your new bite alignment.

treatmentJourney.title: Custom Laboratory Fabrication
treatmentJourney.description: Utilizing our in-house lab capabilities and specialized materials, your final permanent restorations are meticulously crafted to match your facial features and functional needs.

treatmentJourney.title: Final Delivery & Maintenance
treatmentJourney.description: We deliver your final crowns, bridges, or full-arch prosthetics and establish a long-term care plan to protect your investment and maintain your specialized results.

clinic.whyChooseHeadline: Board-Certified Prosthodontics for the Most Complex Cases

whyChoosePillars.title: Specialty-Trained
whyChoosePillars.description: Prosthodontics is a recognized dental specialty — extra years of training specifically for complex cases like yours.

whyChoosePillars.title: Phased Treatment Plan
whyChoosePillars.description: We work in stages your body can heal between, so you never go without teeth and the work is built to last.

whyChoosePillars.title: In-House Digital Lab
whyChoosePillars.description: Custom restorations designed and fabricated in-house for precise fit, predictable results, and faster timelines.

whyChoosePillars.title: Bite & TMJ Expertise
whyChoosePillars.description: A correct bite is the foundation of any reconstruction — we treat the cause, not just the broken teeth.

doctor.name: Dr. A. Alejandra Rodriguez
doctor.bio: Dr. A. Alejandra Rodriguez, DDS is a highly trained prosthodontist dedicated to restoring healthy, confident smiles through advanced restorative and cosmetic dental care. With specialized training in prosthodontics and expertise in digital dentistry, implant restorations, and full-mouth rehabilitation, she provides personalized treatment solutions tailored to each patient's needs. Known for her attentive approach and commitment to excellence, Dr. Rodriguez combines modern techniques with compassionate care to help patients achieve lasting oral health and beautiful results.

reviews.name: Stacey
reviews.text: Everyone in the office is extremely knowledgeable on all the latest technologies available. The doctors are amazing and worked miracles on me. When I thought my case was hopeless I would absolutely recommend everyone to come here.

reviews.name: Justin
reviews.text: Always a great experience. Dr. Rodriguez immediately discovered an issue that had somehow gone unnoticed at my previous dentistry. Very helpful in weighing my options and the procedures have been very gentle.

reviews.name: Betty
reviews.text: You could not find a better all-around dental care anywhere. Dr. Rodriguez is excellent, top of her field, conscientious and a true artist at her work; the staff is fantastic and efficient.

reviews.name: Pasquale
reviews.text: Great experience all around. Office personnel very helpful, Dr. assistant sweet and very knowledgeable. Never felt so confident in my doctor before. Great find. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.name: Mark R.
reviews.text: The full mouth restoration they performed changed my life. As specialists, they understood exactly how to rebuild my bite and smile using the latest digital technology. Truly professional care.

reviews.name: Elena S.
reviews.text: I was nervous about such a complex reconstruction, but the sedation options and the team's expertise made me feel at ease. My new implants and crowns feel and look completely natural.
